changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Commodity price shocks can persist, but policy supply changes are unpredictable.
disconfirmingEvidence: Short-term relative price resilience of oil equities does not change the negative commodity earnings bridge.

causalChain.failureMode: supply agreement rapidly reverses oil prices
